name: Kenya
famous_for: The Great Wildebeest Migration in Maasai Mara, Mount Kenya, red-robed Maasai warriors, and world-record marathon runners.
tourists: Over 2.0M safari visitors annually; famous for Amboseli elephant herds under Kilimanjaro and Lake Nakuru flamingos.
must_know: 'Hakuna Matata' is real Swahili meaning 'no troubles'; the communal concept of Harambee ('pulling together') unites communities.
fun_fact: Every year between July and October, over two million wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles brave crocodile-infested Mara River crossings.
